name: Linear Algebra Isomorphism
description: Transforms local pairwise inequality constraints (graph edges) into a global matrix-vector product condition. Models that rely on surface-level translation will implement the matrix multiplication literally, making incremental pruning during backtracking difficult to express and leading to an unpruned 3^40 search space (TLE). Models that mathematically reason will deduce the product merely enforces p_u != p_v and use standard efficient backtracking.
